stepExplanation:
Finding resistance using P = V²/R:
$$R = \frac{V^2}{P} = \frac{(240)^2}{60} = \frac{57600}{60} = 960 \text{ Ω}$$

Finding current using P = IV:
$$I = \frac{P}{V} = \frac{60}{240} = 0.25 \text{ A}$$

Alternatively, I = V/R = 240/960 = 0.25 A (confirms our answer).
stepBody: Use the power equations with P = 60 W and V = 240 V. Give resistance in ohms and current in amperes.
